title: Farmer's Barks
description: Compatibility between Farmer's Delight and modded bark items
body:
Immersive Weathering by Ordana, as well as its cousin Verdant, introduce new tree-specific bark items. Unfortunately, Farmer's Delight doesn't recognize these items as bark for its crafting recipes, and generic tree bark is unobtainable when running them together.

This datapack establishes a new "bark" Forge tag and allows the following recipes to use any item in the tag:
- Farmer's Delight - Compost from tree bark
- Farmer's Delight - Paper from tree bark
- Vegan Delight - Leather Substitute cooking

The list of "bark" items includes Immersive Weathering and Verdant item names, so the compatability patch works for both. In addition to vanilla trees, bark from any tree in the following mods is supported:
- Would
- Quark
- Biomes o' Plenty
- Hellion's Sniffer+
